messages:
incidents-bot: P1 alert - increased inference latency and 5xx rate in eu-west-1 for hosted API (/v1/generate and /v1/embeddings). Pager dispatched to @sre-oncall. Alerting metrics, traces, and recent deploys. Link: https://alerts.redwood/INC-1789999000

sre-oncall: Ack — I'm on pager. Spawning bridge and taking ownership of the ops timeline.

carla-ops: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/wr/eqX9t — scribe requested. Who can take notes?

alice-m: I'll scribe. Drafting initial status entry now.

dmitri-ml: I can be service owner for model-serving surface. Starting triage: checking GPU utilization, KV cache error counts, and recent kernel logs.

ben-p: Noted customer impact in metrics: 15% of requests hitting 500s since 08:12 UTC, tail latencies up ~3x. Errors concentrated on g4-quant nodes in eu-west-1.

sre-oncall: Paging sanity check — @pagerduty-bot confirm delivery to oncall rotation.

pagerduty-bot: Pager delivered to rotation: oncall-sre (ack required). Delivery timestamp 08:14:05 UTC.

alice-m: Statuspage draft: "Investigating increased inference latency and intermittent errors in eu-west-1 affecting hosted text and embedding endpoints. Engineers are investigating; some requests may time out or receive 500 responses. We will provide updates within 15 minutes." Post in 10 unless updated.

carla-ops: Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/inference-degradation. Recent deploy: deploy-eu-west-2026-03-17-07:50 UTC. Suggest we don't rollback before triage.

dmitri-ml: Agreed no rollback yet. I'm seeing high KV cache pressure on host-12: oom-ish spikes and repeated ReadTimeout on cache client. Trying a targeted cache flush on host-12 and restarting worker there: `ssh host-12 'service inference-worker restart && /opt/tools/kv_flush --shard=12'`

ben-p: If latency holds we'll open temporary routing to eu-central fallback for affected traffic. Notifying product/comms for potential customer message.

alice-m: Comms draft ready for review: "We're investigating degraded service in eu-west-1; mitigation in progress. No indication of data loss. Next update 08:30 UTC." @ben-p please approve.

ben-p: Approved. Post at 08:24 if no material change.

sre-oncall: Assigning owners: owner=@dmitri-ml, scribe=@alice-m, infra=@carla-ops, comms=@ben-p. Next internal update at 08:30 UTC.

dmitri-ml: Ack. Flushed cache and restarted worker on host-12. Watching request success rate and p95.

carla-ops: Fallback route queued; will flip if errors persist beyond next update.

alice-m: Recording action items in incident doc and statuspage queue. Running checklist: impact assessment, rollback decision point, customer comm, postmortem owner.

incidents-bot: Auto-reminder scheduled: update due at 08:30 UTC (300s). Use /incident update to post.

sre-oncall: Quick note — if tail latency still high after cache flush, consider scale-up of serving pool + temporary increased batching to reduce pressure.

ben-p: I'll prepare the external blurb and send to legal if we need to escalate.

alice-m: scribe closing this update thread until 08:30. Add anything urgent to bridge. :thumbsup:
